content: {"like":["Values high-quality visual and audio production, especially with advanced special effects and music scores.","Prefers well-developed characters and strong storytelling that feels human and dramatic.","Enjoys accurate and honest product information, including correct running times and clear packaging.","Appreciates detailed, realistic portrayals of technical processes and engineering work.","Seeks immersive, well-crafted experiences that showcase technology (e.g., 4K visuals, virtual tours)."],"dislike":["Dislikes poor video quality, such as grainy or VHS-like images, and any visual distortion or color issues.","Strongly objects to misleading or false advertising, especially regarding product specs and running time.","Finds generic or unoriginal content unappealing.","Rejects products lacking extras or additional content beyond the main feature.","Avoids experiences that feel inauthentic or overly commercialized."]}
